# Arch-loop follow-up row L -- PLA, nozzle 205C, bed 60C, M221 S100

**Not yet print-tested.** Generated by `arch_test.mjs ... L`. Printed on the **same bed** as `20261029_arch-loop-8-rows-PLA.gcode` -- don't clear the sheet. Row L sits at Y=179, above row K (Y 165).

Calibration line: `freeformSolid` x=120-180, y=25, printed first (the next free step in the calibration sequence; y=75 from the 8-row print and y=40 from row I and y=35 from row J and y=30 from row K are already on this bed). `verifyLayout` against everything already on the bed (3mm min gap): ok=true, 0 warnings.

**Change from row K** (same S 3, 6 loops, anchors, fan on; height: 5mm hair vs row K's 3mm arch):

| | row K | row L |
|---|---|---|
| arch strand e/d (rise, bridge, descent) | 0.075 | 0.075 (same) |
| path shape | lopsided parabola, peak at 0.9mm of 3.0mm (30%) | straight 5.0mm hair, then bent over onto B 3.0mm away |
| speed F (mm/min) | 110 (whole curve) | 110 hair / 600 bend (bend not extruding) |
| arch path length, A to B (mm) | 6.2 | 10.5 |
| filament per arch (mm) | 0.466 | 0.330 |
| time for the whole arch (s) | 3.4 | 3.0 |
| average melt flow over the arch (mm3/s) | 0.33 | 0.26 |

Instead of drawing the arc with the nozzle, the arc is made by bending: first a straight vertical hair 5mm tall (row K's strand and speed), then the nozzle -- still holding the hair's tip -- swings along a quarter-ellipse from the top of the hair down onto B, 3mm away, without extruding. Along that swing the nozzle is never further from A than the hair is long, so the hair is never stretched; it has slack and bends over into an arch. The swing is fast (600mm/min, about 0.6s) so the hair bends while it is still warm instead of setting straight under the fan. Rough expected shape: a 5mm hair over a 3mm span gives an arch somewhat taller than a semicircle (~2mm high).

**No purge line**: the header's purge lines at X10-10.4, Y15-100 are left out (they would print on top of the ones already there). The calibration line is the first extrusion, so it doubles as the prime -- expect its start to be a little thin.

| row | Y | shape | dir | H (mm) | S (mm) | loops | pitch gap | rise / bridge / down F | top dwell | fan | ~mm3/s at bridge | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| L | 179 | hairBend | x | 5.0 | 3.0 | 6 | 3.0 | 110 hair / 600 bend | - | on | 0.33 | straight 5mm hair pulled up from A (e/d 0.075, 110mm/min), then the nozzle swings over and down onto B without extruding (600mm/min), bending the hair into the arc |

**What to look for**: compare directly with row K (Y=165). Did the hair stand straight before the bend? Did it bend into a rounded arch, kink sharply at one point, or snap off the nozzle during the swing? Is the tip glued down at B? Compare height and roundness with rows J and K.

Totals: 1460 G-code lines, 9.9 mm commanded filament.
